summary: C24 implemented, pushed to main and verified by all four hosted workflows. Sensor leaf rotation enforces an exact overlap deadline at C09, with persisted revision/retirement and atomic C08-token offline recovery in C05. Real TLS, restart, cross-service token races, five SIGKILL phases, nine syscall faults, operator CLI, read-only API/UI and isolated web package startup passed. Full hosted Go race and 174 required anchors passed.
scope_limits: Sensor client leaves under one existing C09 issuer; CA migration and listener certificate rotation are separate.
Enable pki.Options.Rotation on the C09 guard; applications call Allows before each protected action. No background forced socket termination is claimed.
Trusted local operator, authoritative wall clock and latest C05 history; no independent anti-rollback clock/checkpoint or distributed storage.
Private CA keys and raw tokens are never persisted in C05 or exposed by the status API. Tokens are deliberately delivered to exclusive 0600 files in private 0700 operator directories.
Internal records are bounded to 8 KiB, public status to 1 MiB and state to explicit C05 quotas; no history truncation or capacity claim.
No public enrollment/ingest, full restore/power-loss, C30 workflow or C40 release certification.
local_environment: The same 14 C13 failures reproduced on unmodified C23; the hosted full suite passed with pinned Podman.
